details_subtitle: WealthX brings likely next steps forward, helps you review what deserves attention, and leaves every financial decision in your hands.
details_title: More intelligence. Less effort to reach it.
faq1_a: No. WealthX is a structured personal finance system for accounts, assets and liabilities, multiple currencies, budgets, Scenarios, transactions, Flows, goals, investments, search, insights, maps, widgets, and data control.
faq1_q: Is WealthX only a budget tracker?
faq2_a: Smart Flows use recent activity and spending frequency to suggest Flows you may need. Choose a Flow, enter the amount, and confirm the entry.
faq3_a: No. Smart Budget uses past transactions and current budgets to suggest changes to amounts or budget periods. You can review each suggestion, and changes apply only after you confirm.
faq3_q: Does Smart Budget change my budget automatically?
faq4_a: No. Scenarios express everyday life, travel, family, and project contexts through budgets. They do not create a direct Scenario-to-Account relationship.
faq4_q: Do Scenarios connect directly to Accounts?
faq5_a: Split Bill allocates one actual payment across multiple budgets. Repayments, reimbursements, and full or partial refunds can stay linked to the original transaction. This is not collaboration or automated settlement.
faq5_q: What can Split Bill and refund records represent?
faq6_a: No. WealthX can track investment accounts, holdings, trades, deposits, withdrawals, buys, sells, and market value for records and context only.
faq7_a: Cashflow Calendar and Spending Heatmap widgets are available to Free users, alongside basic views. Availability of other views and features depends on access.
faq8_a: Yes. You can search your records and use the supported import, export, and backup options. Depending on your platform and settings, records are stored on your device or in your private iCloud database.
faq8_q: Can I search, import, export, and back up my records?
feature_budget_body: Organise budgets around daily life, family, or travel. Review Smart Budget suggestions for future amounts or time frames, and apply only what fits.
feature_budget_point1: Review every suggestion before anything changes.
feature_budget_point2: Plan by month, quarter, year, or project.
feature_budget_point3: Adjust future budget amounts or periods when your plans change.
feature_data_body: Search your records, import and export supported file formats, and create backups to keep a copy of your data.
feature_data_point1: Search transactions, accounts, budgets, goals, holdings, and Flows.
feature_data_point2: Use supported data transfer and backup paths.
feature_data_point3: Keep a portable copy under your control.
feature_data_title: Your records should stay findable and portable.
feature_design_alt: WealthX account overview with visual identity icons
feature_design_body: Most pages have been redesigned to put focus where it belongs. Distinct symbols show recurring, refunded, and completed transaction status, while consistent menu icons make actions easier to recognize at a glance.
feature_design_point1: Recognize transaction status through its symbol.
feature_design_point2: Use consistent icons as the system grows.
feature_design_point3: Choose a theme that makes a precise system feel more like your own.
feature_design_title: The detail you need, before you need to read it.
feature_flows_alt: The Today screen shows common Flows and Planned Flows.
feature_flows_body: Suggested Flows help you start routine entries faster. Use Planned Flows to keep recurring income and bills organised.
feature_flows_point1: Reuse familiar entries without setting them up from scratch.
feature_flows_point2: Record income, expenses, transfers, refunds, and recurring transactions.
feature_flows_point3: Choose a Flow, enter the actual amount, and confirm.
feature_goals_alt: Setting up a financial goal in WealthX
feature_goals_body: Set a goal for saving, paying down debt, or a future purchase. Link the accounts that support it, then follow your progress.
feature_goals_point1: Track savings, repayment, and purchase goals.
feature_goals_point2: Link accounts to track progress from your records.
feature_goals_point3: Keep your goals in view alongside everyday budgets and transactions.
feature_goals_title: Give your plans a clear starting point.
feature_insights_alt: A cash flow chart shows the connections between income, budgets, and spending.
feature_insights_body: Explore cash flow trends, spending by category, and how money moves between income and expenses. Allow location access to view your recorded locations on a map.
feature_insights_point1: See where your money goes and how spending changes over time.
feature_insights_point2: Search transactions, accounts, budgets, goals, holdings, and Flows.
feature_insights_point3: Explore your records through maps, charts, and widgets.
feature_investments_body: Keep records of investment accounts, holdings, trades, deposits, withdrawals, and market value. WealthX does not provide investment advice, predictions, or guaranteed returns.
feature_investments_point1: Review holdings and account value in one place.
feature_investments_point2: Record buys, sells, deposits, and withdrawals.
feature_investments_point3: Understand long-term assets alongside budgets and goals.
feature_scenarios_body: Everyday life, travel, family, and projects can keep their own purpose and boundaries. Scenarios express those contexts through budgets and do not bind directly to an Account.
feature_scenarios_point1: Switch between scenarios without rebuilding your records.
feature_scenarios_point2: Keep context-specific budgets and insights readable.
feature_scenarios_point3: Use one app while preserving separate views for different needs.
feature_scenarios_title: Give each part of life its own context.
feature_split_body: Split one actual payment across multiple budgets, then keep shared-expense repayments, reimbursements, and full or partial refunds linked to the original transaction.
feature_split_point1: Allocate one payment without duplicating the transaction.
feature_split_point2: See the original payment and what followed together.
feature_split_point3: Record the financial meaning without implying collaboration or automatic settlement.
feature_split_title: One payment. Every purpose stays clear.
feature_widgets_alt: WealthX widgets on an iPhone Home Screen show cash flow trends and category summaries.
feature_widgets_body: Add a WealthX widget to see cash flow trends and category summaries at a glance. The information shown depends on the widget you choose.
feature_widgets_point1: See cashflow days and spending patterns from the Home Screen.
feature_widgets_point2: Use System, Light, and Dark themes for free.
feature_widgets_point3: Extended themes remain available with the corresponding access.
feature_widgets_title: A clearer view, right on your Home Screen

privacy_sec1_body: WealthX works with personal finance records that you create or import, including accounts, transactions, budgets, scenarios, Flows, investments, goals, chart settings, icons, and related notes.
privacy_sec1_item1: Finance records are stored on your device or in your private iCloud/CloudKit database. They are not uploaded to the WealthX account and subscription service.
privacy_sec1_item2: Location is optional and is used for Cashflow Map only when you grant permission.
privacy_sec1_item3: Custom images, emoji, and system symbols are used for personalization only when you choose them.
privacy_sec1_item4: On iOS, you can choose whether to enable iCloud sync. On macOS, WealthX Pro requires an available iCloud account and keeps CloudKit sync enabled while the workspace is unlocked.
privacy_sec2_body: To verify WealthX Pro access and support entitlements across supported platforms, WealthX processes limited account and subscription metadata.
privacy_sec2_item1: Account metadata may include an internal WealthX user ID, an Apple-verified App Transaction identifier, a SHA-256 one-way digest derived from the current CloudKit user record identifier, an app account token, a hashed session token, platform, and verification timestamps.
privacy_sec2_item2: Subscription metadata may include Apple or Stripe purchase and subscription identifiers, product, plan, status, expiry, trial state, verification timestamps, and a Stripe customer identifier when Stripe applies.
privacy_sec2_item3: The raw CloudKit user record identifier and signed App Transaction are processed to verify the account but are not retained in raw form.
privacy_sec2_item4: WealthX does not receive payment-card or bank-account details entered with Apple or Stripe.
privacy_sec3_body: Account and subscription metadata is used only to authenticate sessions, verify or restore Pro access across supported platforms, prevent conflicting account claims, maintain entitlement status, provide account support, and carry out account deletion. WealthX does not use this information for advertising or tracking.
privacy_sec4_body: Apple provides App Store, StoreKit, and iCloud/CloudKit services. Stripe processes Stripe subscriptions when applicable. Render hosts the WealthX account and subscription service and may process network request metadata. We do not sell personal finance data or account metadata. Information is disclosed only as needed to operate these services, when required by law, to protect rights and safety, or at your request.
privacy_sec5_body: Finance records remain on your device or in your private iCloud database. WealthX limits the account and subscription metadata it stores, and hashes tokens or encrypts credentials where appropriate. This metadata is retained while your WealthX account exists or as reasonably needed to operate and secure the service, meet legal obligations, or resolve disputes. No digital system should be treated as risk-free.
privacy_sec6_body: You control import and export workflows. Locking WealthX hides finance data and stops app access to CloudKit, but does not delete the underlying records. After a confirmed WealthX account deletion succeeds, WealthX removes the server-side account, sessions, entitlement records, App Transaction/CloudKit binding, applicable legacy installation mapping, and pending Stripe Checkout state.
privacy_sec6_item1: Deleting a WealthX account does not cancel an Apple or Stripe subscription. Manage or cancel each subscription through its billing provider.
privacy_sec6_item2: Local and private-iCloud finance records remain after account deletion. You can manage or remove them separately in WealthX or through Apple platform settings where applicable.
privacy_sec6_item3: Files you export are external copies under your control. Locking or deleting WealthX does not remove those files.
privacy_sec7_body: WealthX is not intended for children below the age required by local law to manage personal finance records without appropriate consent.
privacy_subtitle: Your finance records remain under your control; WealthX services process only the limited account and subscription metadata needed to verify access.

wx_sharing_body: For trips, meals, and plans together. Track who paid, each person’s share, and what is left to settle.
wx_sharing_alt: Expense Sharing shows $200.00 fully allocated and states that no transfers are needed.
wx_sharing_caption: The expense is fully allocated; no transfer is needed in this example.
wx_sharing_scope: Available in project budgets within a Scenario. Adding or editing prepayments, changing shares, and using Checkout require WealthX Pro.
wx_reconcile_title: Check your statement before adding entries
wx_reconcile_body: Import a supported bank or payment statement and compare it with your records. Review matches, differences, and entries awaiting confirmation, then choose what to confirm.
wx_reconcile_alt: A WealthX statement-reconciliation screen for reviewing imported entries.
wx_sharing_step1_body: Record who paid on the group’s behalf and how much.
wx_sharing_step2_body: Choose the people included in each prepayment, then divide the cost equally, by percentage, or by amount.
wx_sharing_step3_body: Review who owes whom and the suggested net transfers. Once payments are complete outside WealthX, use Checkout to finish.
wx_sharing_faq1_q: How is Expense Sharing different from Split Bill?
wx_sharing_faq1_a: Expense Sharing tracks payments made on behalf of a group, each person’s share, and suggested transfers to settle up. Split Bill allocates a single payment across multiple budgets.
wx_sharing_faq2_a: No. Send or receive the money using your usual payment method, then use Checkout in WealthX to confirm that the payments are complete.
wx_sharing_faq3_q: Where can I use Expense Sharing?
wx_sharing_faq3_a: Open a project budget in a Scenario to record prepayments, assign each person’s share, and review settlement suggestions.
